shortDescription: Folo is the AI RSS reader for Windows. Follow blogs, news, newsletters, videos and podcasts in one calm timeline, then let AI summarize, translate and answer questions about everything you follow.
features: Follow RSS, Atom and JSON feeds, plus thousands of RSSHub routes for sites without a feed
One timeline for articles, social posts, pictures, videos, podcasts and notifications
AI summaries for any article, on demand or automatically
AI translation shown side by side or on its own, in English, Chinese, Japanese or French
Chat with AI about an article, a feed, a folder or your whole timeline
Summarize your timeline into a quick digest
AI tasks that deliver daily or weekly briefings to chat or email
Connect MCP services to bring your other tools into Folo AI
Choose your AI model or bring your own API key
Actions: rules that filter, star, rewrite, notify or summarize new entries
Send articles to Obsidian, Readwise, Instapaper, Zotero, Cubox, Outline, Readeck or Eagle
Inbox with its own email address for newsletters
Customizable keyboard shortcuts and a command menu
Themes, reading fonts, custom CSS and code highlighting
Spotlight highlights the keywords you care about
Sync across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iPhone, iPad and the web
Open source under AGPL-3.0, with no ads
screenshotCaptions: All your feeds in one calm timeline, with Folo AI one click away.
Ask Folo AI about an article, a feed or everything you follow.
Turn hundreds of new entries into one quick digest.
Read articles side by side with an AI translation in English, Chinese, Japanese or French.
Pictures, videos and podcasts each get a layout made for them.
Schedule AI tasks for daily or weekly briefings.
Send articles to your notes and read-later tools, or connect MCP services.
Make it yours with themes, reading fonts and keyboard shortcuts.
